name: stack-feel
description: Placing a chest on top of a chest without any plank or floor: the ghost turns valid, the chest is placed, nothing collapses

steps.message: Build a wood chest on open ground. Pick a second wood chest and aim at the TOP of the first one, no planks anywhere: is the ghost white/blue (valid) and not red?
Press Q / E to select a Bottom point and aim near a Top corner of the lower chest. Does it lock on, sit flush, and can you place it?
Place a third chest on top (a stack of 3). Open each chest and put an item in: does every chest open and keep its items? Remove the middle chest: nothing collapses.
Aim a chest at a stone wall or a bed: behaviour is the same as without the mod. Set [Stacking] Enable = false in the F6 hub: the chest-on-chest ghost is red again.
